_comment: Workshop-wide schema registry — every schema-shaped surface tracked at dev time. See Docs/agent-guides/schemas.md for authoring guidance. Verified by scripts/lint-schemas.js (release:preflight gate). v0.113.0 (workshop 0.113.0).

schemas.notes: EOD review sidecar — JSON Schema draft-07. Latest accepted version 1.4.0 (v0.101.0 sparse-signal-feedback).
Morning briefing sidecar. Latest accepted version 1.1.0.
Midday tripwire sidecar. Tripwire-aspects (cc_drift / calendar_drift / queue_growth) gated by engagement.tripwire_aspects.
Weekly review sidecar.
Monthly review sidecar.
Cold-mode morning briefing sidecar (v0.95.1 lens_shift cadence). Skips memory-read + anti-echo + semantic-echoes.
Canonical Cowork scheduled-job wrapper contract. contract_version MUST mirror cowork blueprint version (landmine #20). Substitution tokens {{$varname}} + {{shared.<key>}}.
Canonical 7-entry kind→title display map (v0.95.0). loadKindTitles() reads this; CANONICAL_TITLES const is the in-helper fallback.
Kind-classification patterns used by context-builder MCP-routing.
Memoized classifier results to avoid redundant LLM calls. Cache entries keyed by namespace + tool-set hash.
Per-cadence freshness windows (how recent a gather result is allowed to be before it triggers re-fetch).

learned_weights schema is encoded as normalizeLearnedWeightsV3 / V4 / V5 migrators inside ingest-feedback-helper.js. Schema 5 (v0.101.0) added per-cadence satisfaction series; schema 4 (v0.99.0) added silence-reset migration; schema 3 (v0.98.2) added nested per-kind entity maps. Migration is always purely additive — counters intact across version bumps.

11 rule_fragments covering: budget / paycheck / invoice / debt / budget-defaults / paycheck-defaults / debt-defaults / month / finance-plan (v0.10.0) / savings-accounts (v0.10.0) / hub types. Budget fragment carries optional `debt_allocations[]` + `savings_allocations[]` arrays (finance month-reality WS2 — per-row plan/override allocations, never summed into the discretionary envelope). Validates frontmatter on per-blueprint paths via the validator mechanism.

24 rule_fragments — largest bundle. Covers 7 atomic-note types (cowork-morning-briefing / midday-tripwire / eod-review / weekly-review / monthly-review / finance-snapshot / scheduled-jobs) + hub types + memory types.
4 rule_fragments: project / doc-note / section-hub / sub-section-hub (v0.103.0 section-hubs + breadcrumbs).

Workshop master manifest. Keys: workshop_version, blueprints[], mechanisms[], foundational_plugins. check-version-sync.js gates workshop_version vs package.json vs ranch/platform-subscription.json at preflight start.
Workshop's own subscription file (workshop dogfoods itself per build-test-verify.md). Pinned to the workshop's own manifest version. Per-vault consumer subscriptions follow the same shape.

Finance has 4 new_entity_button entries: budget / paycheck / invoice / debt. Each declares prompts[] (text/date/number/select fields), destination, frontmatter_template, inline_body. entity-create@0.7.1 consumes seed_from_defaults.resolve_wikilinks (v0.108.0).

Engagement shape read out of consumer vault-config.md: {id, label, type, priorities[], rendering[], tripwire_aspects[], overrides{}, ...}. Layered preferences tree (bundle ⨁ overrides ⨁ ad_hoc → final). v0.95.0 introduced overrides; per-key wins on objects, REPLACES on arrays.

MonthlyOverview (v0.110.3) reads page.type === 'budget' + page.month + page.categories[*].actual + dv.pages('spice/finance/paychecks').where(p => p.type === 'paycheck' && (p.pay_period_end || p.pay_period_start).startsWith(monthKey)) + dv.pages('spice/finance/debts').where(p => p.type === 'debt'). Paychecks attribute to the month they are paid (pay_period_end, start fallback). Paycheck expenses[*].debt + paid:true expected when summing debtPaid. Behavioral coverage in platform/test/run-v01103-monthly-overview.js.

FinanceMath.computePlanState(dv, monthKey) (v0.10.0) reads the type:'finance-plan' singleton (income_floor / fixed_living_monthly / attack_above_minimums / pay_periods_per_month / savings_glide / roll_freed_savings_to_attack / overflow / avalanche_order_by / attack_target_override) + debts + type:'savings-account' under spice/finance/savings + paychecks + the month's + prior month's budget. Returns { ok, envelope, savings, attack, allocation[], payoff, overflow, whatIf, applyPlan }. ok:false reason:'no-plan' when the singleton is absent (degrade-gracefully). Behavioral coverage in platform/test/run-finance-plan-state.js.
v0.116.0 — Recurring Tasks registry frontmatter (type: to-do-recurring). Validated via the to-do manifest's rule_fragment for path_glob 'spice/to-do/Recurring Tasks.md'.

v0.116.0 — Per-project To-Do note frontmatter (type: project-todo). Validated via the project manifest's rule_fragment with frontmatter_branch on type. Backfilled by applyProjectTodoBackfill in install.js.

Aggregated at install time from per-blueprint manifest `breadcrumb: { types: { ... } }` blocks via applyBreadcrumb in install.js. First-match-wins over contributions{} keyed by current-note `type` frontmatter. Schema: { schema_version:1, contributions:{ <bp>:{ types:{ <type>:{ ancestors[], current? } } } } } where each segment has { when?:{}, label, link? } with `|`-chain labels + `{atom}` template links + `fm:`/`path:`/`file:`/`lit:` + `slug:` transform resolver grammar. See Docs/plans/2026-06-17-v0.123.0-breadcrumb-mechanism-design.md.

Aggregated at install from per-blueprint manifest nav_buttons blocks via applyNavButtons in install.js. Read-modify-write so the registry accumulates across the install loop, with prune-on-empty for re-installs. SpaceNavButtons reads it at render time.

Aggregated at install from per-blueprint manifest new_entity_buttons[] specs via applyNewEntityButtons in install.js. Schema: { schema_version:1, contributions:{ <bp>:[...] }, entries:[...] } with a flattened top-level entries[] view. EntityCreate reads it at render time.
